reasons.plausibility: The liquid-metal dealloying and interfacial stabilization mechanisms are scientifically grounded for these alloy systems, though referencing multiple compositions in one statement introduces some confusion.
reasons.testability: They describe clear structural and property measurements (SEM/TEM, XRD, thermal conductivity, helium irradiation testing) that would directly support or refute the claimed improvements.
reasons.usefulness: The proposed intervention and measurements could guide researchers looking to enhance W–Cu composites under fusion-relevant conditions, despite the lengthy and somewhat mixed composition details.
